name: mod-dock
description: A dock above the prompt that lists every mod you have built, marks which are loaded in this session, and opens or closes each mod's window with one click. A Mods N/M button in the prompt footer and the /dock pane reach the same list when another mod holds the band. A mod that is not loaded is never copied or loaded by the dock: a pick says to run /reload-plugins (installed) or sync.sh (not installed). Shows an installed mod's installed version. Reads mod manifests, the installed-plugin registry and the slash-command list. Writes nothing, sends nothing out and stores nothing.

hidden.title: Hidden mods
hidden.description: Mod names the dock leaves out of its list, separated by commas.

modsDir.title: Mods folder
modsDir.description: Folder that holds one sub-folder per session, each with mods inside (the dev-mods folder). Leave empty to find it from where the dock itself is installed.
